mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals a potential economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained decline over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show an increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in a month, coupled with a federal funds rate below 1%, signals inflationary pressure without sufficient monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% and FEDFUNDS was below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase over two consecutive months.
